title: A criterion for S and N to be quasi-inverse equivalences
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-S-N at source lines 4231-4245: for exact functors N : A to B and S : B to A, if there is an isomorphism N S to the identity of B, N is faithful and S is essentially surjective, then S and N are quasi-inverse equivalences. The proof at source lines 4247-4259 reduces to producing a functorial isomorphism S N A to A, chooses an isomorphism f : A to S(B) using essential surjectivity, writes down the candidate composite f^{-1} composed with g at S(B) composed with S N f, and states that it is independent of the choices and functorial in A. The verification of the independence is delegated in one sentence, so the card's content is the construction together with the exactness hypothesis, which is what makes the middle map available.
